title: VulnReport
description: Documentation Agent -> human approval gate (docs/ARCHITECTURE.md §2/§3(4)): structured vulnerability report. Critical severity forces requires_human_gate=true, backing 'nothing critical self-publishes.'

recording_ref.description: Optional (issue #77/P3.36). Directory under evals/recordings/ (trailing slash, no filename) containing the committed, replayable draw(s) that back this report -- the report's own pointer to its evidence, so a reader does not have to cross-reference docs/ATO_EVIDENCE_PACKET.md §5.2 to find it. Deliberately a directory, not a single draw file: build_vuln_report() derives it from the source exploit_record's case_id (evals/recordings/<case_id>/), matching the convention every case's recordings already follow (see tools/build_vuln_reports.py::_load_recordings). Computed by build_vuln_report(), never hand-typed -- see redteam/agents/documentation.py.
